title: Ticket Volume per Seat at ClearPath Renewal
content:
## Rule

The service-intensity adjustment of the renewal rate on an automatic renewal of a ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement compares the tickets opened on the agreement in the last 12 months (a month window ending today) with the agreement's seat count (the users currently covered):
- 3 or more tickets per seat of the seat count add 1.0 percent to the renewal rate;
- fewer tickets than the seat count take 0.5 percent off;
- anything between adds nothing.

A whole month between two dates is counted only once the later date reaches the same day of the month as the earlier one, and a month window of N months ending today takes the entries dated fewer than N whole months before today. Tickets are counted by the moment each was opened in the agreement's ticket history.

## Points of judgement

| Seat count | Tickets opened in the window | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| 40 | 120 or more | 1.0 percent added |
| 40 | 40 to 119 | nothing |
| 40 | 39 or fewer | 0.5 percent taken off |

- With 40 seats, 120 tickets is exactly 3 per seat and adds 1.0 percent; 119 tickets adds nothing.
- 40 tickets equals the seat count, which is not fewer, so nothing is taken off; 39 tickets takes 0.5 percent off.
